councillors.source_quote:
9.6    Committee Terms of Reference

             MOVED BY: SZPAK
             SECONDED: GUIRY

             THAT Council approve the proposed terms of reference in form and content included with
             this report, excepting minor changes;

             AND

             That Council appoint Councillor Wagner, Councillor Szpak, and Councillor Guiry, to the
             Sustainable Development Advisory Committee;

             AND

             That Council appoint Councillor Morley, Councillor Yacucha, and Councillor Harder, to the
             Community Advisory Committee;

             AND

             That Council direct staff to post the committee positions to the City's website and in the
             Goldstream Gazette for interested members of the community to apply.

                                                                                            Motion CARRIED.

whiteway.source_quote:
THAT Council appoint Jacquie Whiteway to the Community Advisory Committee
                        for a term ending on December 31, 2026.
